result.markdown:
Assuming you mean **Newcastle upon Tyne, UK**, I’d shortlist these firms rather than simply choosing the one with the biggest advertising budget.

### My shortlist

1. **Thompsons Solicitors — strongest specialist choice**
   - Particularly focused on personal injury rather than being a general high-street practice.
   - Their Newcastle team handles road accidents, workplace accidents, medical negligence and asbestos-related claims on a **no-win-no-fee** basis. [www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk](https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/tyne-and-wear/newcastle-upon-tyne/thompsons-solicitors-llp?workArea=personal-injury&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Their Newcastle office has a **4.7/5 rating** in the business search.
   - **My pick if your injury is serious or your employer/insurer is disputing liability.**

2. **Slater and Gordon Lawyers — excellent all-rounder**
   - Large specialist personal-injury practice with a Newcastle office.
   - Their Newcastle team is recognised by **Chambers and Legal 500**, and the firm says its personal-injury work is primarily conducted on a **No Win, No Fee** basis. [www.slatergordon.co.uk](https://www.slatergordon.co.uk/contact-us/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Good choice for road accidents, workplace injuries, serious injuries and medical negligence.
   - Their published terms explain that if the claim succeeds, a success fee can be deducted from compensation, so I'd ask for the exact percentage before signing. [www.slatergordon.co.uk](https://www.slatergordon.co.uk/personal-injury-claim/road-traffic-accidents/whiplash/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. **Shaw & Co Solicitors — worth considering as a smaller local firm**
   - Newcastle-based and focused on personal injury/compensation work.
   - The business search shows **4.7/5**, although there are considerably fewer reviews than the large firms.
   - Independent local coverage reports that they offer no-win-no-fee arrangements and highlights positive client feedback. [www.allrightnewcastle.co.uk](https://www.allrightnewcastle.co.uk/best-personal-injury-lawyers-newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - I'd consider them if you prefer a smaller firm and more direct solicitor contact.

4. **Hudgell Solicitors — particularly worth a look for serious/complex injury**
   - Offers No Win No Fee for various personal-injury and medical-negligence claims, with the success fee agreed in advance. [www.hudgellsolicitors.co.uk](https://www.hudgellsolicitors.co.uk/personal-injury/road-traffic-accidents/pedestrian-accident-claims?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - I'd put them on the comparison list for **serious injury, medical negligence, brain injury or complex cases**.

### One I'd be cautious about

**Winn Solicitors** has an enormous number of Google reviews and a strong overall Google rating, but its independent ReviewSolicitors profile is much less reassuring: **1.8/5 from 56 reviews**, with numerous complaints about delays and communication. [www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk](https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/tyne-and-wear/newcastle-upon-tyne/winn-solicitors-limited?workArea=personal-injury&utm_source=chatgpt.com) One recent 2026 review specifically described unanswered emails and changing case handlers. [www.solicitor.info](https://www.solicitor.info/winn-solicitors-limited/newcastle-upon-tyne/?rating=1&service=&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

That doesn't mean they can't handle a good claim, but **I'd personally get quotes from two or three alternatives before instructing them**.

### What I'd do

I'd get **free initial assessments from Thompsons, Slater & Gordon and Shaw & Co**, then compare the actual CFA (No Win No Fee) terms—not just whether they advertise "no win, no fee."

Ask each solicitor these four questions:

- **What percentage of my compensation could you deduct as a success fee?**
- **Will I have to pay anything if the claim loses?**
- **Are insurance premiums or other expenses deducted from my compensation?**
- **Who will actually handle my case, and how much experience do they have with claims like mine?**

The headline "No Win No Fee" doesn't necessarily mean **you keep 100% of the compensation**, so this comparison is important.

[Slater + Gordon Newcastle office](https://www.slatergordon.co.uk/contact-us/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Thompsons Newcastle personal injury information](https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/tyne-and-wear/newcastle-upon-tyne/thompsons-solicitors-llp?workArea=personal-injury&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me what happened** (e.g. car accident, workplace injury, medical negligence, trip/fall, etc.) and roughly when it happened, I can narrow this down to **the 2–3 Newcastle firms I'd actually contact for your particular claim**.
